The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ff3098c8faf29685), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Φ∗ be the map of Proposition 3.5 for Equation (3.19), with axis values Equation (3.5). Its ADM energy is M, its angular momentum in the present convention is J = −aM, its charges are Q, 0, and its horizon area is 4πR2. It is independent of Killing time. Define w = sinh σ sin ϑ, q∗ = 1 2 log(W sin2 ϑ). With Euclidean strip derivatives, it satisfies divG(w dΦ∗) = 0, −∆q∗ = |∂Φ∗|2 G, q∗(0, ϑ) = log(R2 sin ϑ). (3.20) The canonical slice and its tensor and fields extend smoothly to the bifurcation sphere, including the ordinary axis poles. Its potentials have the regularity of Lemma 3.3; their renormalized components and u∗ − log sin ϑ have bounded derivatives on compact closed strip ranges.
